subject: history
concept: Applying early civilizations knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple early settlement, choosing a location and explaining their reasoning
exercise.abstract: Student explains their settlement location choice in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: location choice is justified with a real early-civilization reasoning factor (water, farmland, trade)
misconception_flags: chooses a settlement location with no connection to early-civilization survival factors

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
